name: co-utility
description: Standalone utility/tool application — multi-interface YouTube downloader (Flask web UI + pywebview desktop shell + CLI) over one core service, with runtime-output isolation, a 16-locale i18n matrix, and external-input security audits. Lean co-utility roster: PM, Backend, Frontend, QA, Security + common i18n-specialist; security-monitor absorbed into security (2026-11-19).

agent_manifest.notes: Utility-project roster: backend and frontend own the code surfaces (serial writes), i18n-specialist is engaged on locale deliverables (common extends-stub), qa runs the test gate, security audits external-input paths and owns ongoing monitoring. security-monitor was absorbed into security (2026-11-19).
